title: CombatX
body:
Combat X is a simple and effective plugin that prevents players from escaping fights unfairly.

When a player hits another player, they enter combat and a timer appears in the action bar showing how long they’re still in combat. While this timer is active, they can’t safely leave the server. If they disconnect before the timer runs out, they will be killed, making sure fights stay fair.

Once the timer finishes, they’re no longer in combat and can leave without any consequences.

You can easily customize the combat duration in the config, so it fits perfectly with your server’s playstyle.
